other_failure_modes.name: Validation data leakage during preprocessing
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes preprocessing statistics (such as scaling, median imputation, frequency encoding, and aggregations) on the entire training set before splitting it into training and validation subsets. This leaks validation set statistics into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Overfitting blending weights to validation set
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the same validation set for both early stopping of the base models and for optimizing the blending weights. Because the base models are already tuned to this validation set, their predictions are overly optimistic, leading to biased and overfitted blending weights.

other_failure_modes.name: Improper handling of categorical features in neural network
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical variables are label-encoded and standard-scaled alongside numerical features, then fed directly into the linear layers of the neural network. This improperly treats nominal categorical variables as ordinal and continuous, which can degrade neural network performance.

summary: The agent implements a solid modeling pipeline with diverse base models, extensive feature engineering, and an optimized blender. However, the solution suffers from severe data leakage because preprocessing, target encoding, and train/validation splits overlap improperly, causing validation targets and statistics to leak into training features. Additionally, the blending weights are overfitted to the same validation set used for early stopping, and the temporal structure of the data is ignored during splitting.
